<DOCSTRING>
Divides two numbers and returns the result.

Divides the first number (`a`) by the second number (`b`). Throws an error if the second number is zero, indicating division by zero is not allowed.

@param {number} a - Dividend to divide.
@param {number} b - Divisor to divide by.
@throws {Error} Throws an error if the second number is zero, indicating division by zero is not allowed.
</DOCSTRING>
